functionKeys: F3=Exit   F5=Refresh   F7=Page up   F8=Page down   F12=Cancel
notes: Blue-team / COSO monitoring — ENTTYP(AF PW) with CPYAUDJRNE OUTFILE for analytics. Lab journal rows are synthetic but follow QAUDJRN column layout.
auditNotes: Filtered view of QAUDJRN by ENTTYP — primary Blue Team triage before CPYAUDJRNE export or SIEM forward. Pair ENTTYP(AF PW) with WRKACTJOB for live correlation.
qmgtoolsRelation: QMGTOOLS COLESADTA dumps QAS9AUDLOG (ESA), not QAUDJRN — do not confuse service agent log with security audit journal.
